The large-trade limit now comes from the Mongoose server config, and both new nodes run in the compiled processor. The sample run flagged two trades as large, and the final alert count is 2.

**Flagged as large (limit 300000)**

| Symbol | Price × volume | Notional | Large? | alertCount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AAPL | 195.30 × 1200 | 234,360 | no | — |
| MSFT | 410.10 × 800 | 328,080 | **yes** | 1 |
| GOOG | 155.75 × 1500 | 233,625 | no | — |
| AMZN | 178.22 × 640 | 114,060.8 | no | — |
| NVDA | 905.60 × 2100 | 1,901,760 | **yes** | 2 |
